title: Climate zones of Asia
intro: Name the Koppen-Geiger climate class of each city in Asia. The class is read from a 1 km map for the city's location.

questions.prompt: Which Koppen-Geiger climate class does Mashhad, Iran (Islamic Republic of) have?
choices: Dfa: Cold, no dry season, hot summer
Dwb: Cold, dry winter, warm summer
questions.explain: On the Beck et al. 1980-2016 map, Mashhad lies in class BWk: Arid, desert, cold.

questions.prompt: Which Koppen-Geiger climate class does Thimphu, Bhutan have?

questions.explain: On the Beck et al. 1980-2016 map, Thimphu lies in class Cwb: Temperate, dry winter, warm summer.
